problem.title: Valid Parentheses
problem.statement: Given a string s containing only the characters ( ) [ ] { }, return true if every opening bracket is closed by the same type of bracket in the correct order, and every closing bracket has a matching opening bracket.

events.text: I need to check that every bracket in a string is closed by the same type, in the right order. String up to 10^4 chars, only ()[]{}. Target O(n) time.
Good. What's your first approach, and its complexity?
I'll push opening brackets on a stack and pop when I see the matching closer.
Before you code: what input would break a naive version of that?
What should happen when a closing bracket arrives and the stack is already empty?
Think it through and tell me your answer.
